priority: R1 first; R2 deferred if R1 reaches the sole experiment; no result-based switching
mechanism: Independent Bitcoin attention-reversal hypothesis motivated by ElBahrawy et al. 2019, not an exact replication or Liu-Tsyvinski momentum strategy

calendar.reason: Last four complete calendar years, fixed before fetching any new data

known_input_exclusion.reason: Wikimedia official traffic data-loss incident; exclude decision if either input day overlaps, no imputation

availability.scope: Reconstructed public-data negative screen only; 36h lag exceeds documented usual daily load plus cache, not a first-publication guarantee. Positive result requires PIT/incident audit before any candidate qualification.

price_control.new_price: entry calendar day minus 1 at 00:00 UTC trade open
price_control.old_price: entry calendar day minus 2 at 00:00 UTC trade open
price_control.direction: contrarian: short if new > old, long if new < old

cost.basis: Fixed reference stress assumption, not verified account tier or historical executed costs
cost.funding: Signed actual historical rate times hourly mark open and signed quantity for entry <= timestamp < exit

economy.quantity: allocation times pre-entry reference NAV divided by slipped entry price; constant during each 24h position
economy.risk: Hourly mark OHLC drawdown lower/upper bounds; >= limit lower is REJECT, upper-only is INSUFFICIENT_RISK_ORDER. Stop immediately; no invented intrabar fill, no later outcome computation.
controls: same-day price contrarian with identical costs
economy.statistic: Unit-notional mean net and paired differences to both controls
economy.positive_requirements: Complete fixed path with no risk stop; all three lower bounds > 0; both two-year halves have positive mean net. Positive means WORTH_INDEPENDENT_CHECK only, never qualified.
economy.nonpositive: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE unless definite reference-risk breach gives REJECT
